title: S3 bucket allows public read
description: Bucket policy/ACL grants anonymous read to all objects.
remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access at account and bucket level; remove public policies.

title: Security group opens SSH to 0.0.0.0/0
description: An inbound SG rule permits TCP 22 from anywhere.
remediation: Restrict SSH to a known CIDR or use SSM Session Manager.

title: IAM user has AdministratorAccess
description: A non-break-glass IAM user is attached to AdministratorAccess.
remediation: Replace broad policy with scoped permissions; use a role with MFA.

title: RDS storage is unencrypted
description: The database instance has no storage encryption.
remediation: Recreate from an encrypted snapshot with KMS storage encryption.

title: CloudTrail not enabled in all regions
description: Management events are not recorded across all regions.
remediation: Create a multi-region trail with log-file validation to a protected bucket.

title: Root account has active access keys
description: Long-lived access keys exist on the root user.
remediation: Delete all root access keys; enforce MFA on root; use roles for automation.
